data.narrative:
Asylon Robotics is a Series B-stage autonomous systems company operating in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The company has raised $40M to date. The relevant peer universe comprises 8 private companies in the same sector, including Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, and Joby Aviation, with no public comparables available.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $40M capital raised as a proxy baseline. This approach yields an implied valuation of $76M. A peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum sample thresholds (only 1 direct-stage peer identified across the broader 7-peer Drones & Autonomous set), making sector-wide median extrapolation unreliable.

The triangulated valuation range is $65M to $87M, centered on a median of $76M. This range reflects the confidence bounds around a single-method analysis. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 1.9x multiplier for this specific founder team and sub-sector focus, and the limited ability to benchmark against true peer cohorts at identical stage and capital efficiency. A more robust conclusion would require either additional same-stage private market data or disclosure of Asylon's revenue or user metrics relative to named peers.
